unavailableMessage: This invitation is invalid, unavailable, or has expired.
claimDisclosureBody:
You are claiming one planned hand in this circle.

The payout order is not final yet. Before the circle starts, you will review and accept your exact contribution amount, frequency, payout position, payout date, fees, and total obligation.

This action does not authorize a payment.
claimDisclosureConditional: If a planned hand matches your verified email or phone, this action will claim that hand provisionally. Otherwise, your request will be sent to the organizer.
claimAckLabel: I understand that this claim is provisional and final acceptance will be required before the circle starts.
loginPrompt: Sign in or create an account to join this circle. We'll bring you right back here.
genericError: The request could not be completed. Please try again.

organizer.circleMissing: The server did not return this circle.
organizer.completedLocked: This circle is completed. Membership and payout order cannot be changed.
organizer.startedLocked: Membership, additional positions, and payout order are locked after the circle starts. New hands cannot be added.
organizer.circleInviteSubtitle: Share the circle code or general invite link. People without a planned hand go to pending requests for organizer approval.
organizer.shareCircleSubtitle: Code or general link — unmatched joiners go to pending requests
organizer.claimSubtitle: Each unclaimed hand has its own secure claim link. Share the correct link so the person connects to that payout position.
organizer.allClaimedSubtitle: Every planned hand is connected to a CircuSave account. You can still share the circle code for new join requests.
organizer.handLimitMessage: Free accounts are limited to 20 hands per circle. Upgrade to Organizer Pro to add more.
organizer.addPlannedSubtitle: This creates a planned hand on the roster. The person must claim it to connect their CircuSave account. It does not make them a member automatically.
